store.summary: Wi-Fi lab auditing and GPS Wi-Fi and BLE wardriving for the Cardputer Zero.
store.description: Use Auto WiFi Attack or Manual WiFi Attack for authorized lab auditing with a compatible USB Wi-Fi adapter. Save WPA capture results locally or submit usable hashes to OnlineHashCrack. Wardriving uses a GNSS HAT for GPS-tagged Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE observations, with optional WiGLE or WDG Wars upload. Meshmapping listens for MeshCore advertisements through the SX1262 cap and can export mapped nodes to WDG Wars. The foreground app opens from the stock launcher. Privileged radio access requires the Cardputer user's password.
